_note: Graphics API choice (app/gfx.rs). No Godot counterpart: the Godot project uses the engine's own renderer. boot_marker is a file in the per-user folder, holding a process id, written before a Metal window opens and removed by a clean end (after good_frames drawn frames, or at a normal exit); a marker whose process is gone at the next launch means the Metal start crashed and AUTO uses OpenGL. auto_metal_on_apple_silicon: AUTO gives OpenGL everywhere until Metal is measured faster than OpenGL on a device (docs/GRAPHICS_API.md has the numbers); set it to true to give Apple Silicon Metal under AUTO.

web._note: The browser build on Intel MacBook Airs (15-65 FPS). default_tier: the quality tier the browser starts on until the hardware report or the governor says otherwise (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH). high_dpi: whether the canvas is created at device pixels (false: CSS pixels, so a Retina Air fills a quarter of the pixels). max_pixel_ratio: the most the device pixel ratio may multiply the 3D target by when high_dpi is on. render_scale_cap: the 3D target never renders above this share of the canvas in the browser. page_paces_frames: requestAnimationFrame already paces the loop, so the FPS LIMIT wait is skipped in the browser. sections_only_when_shown: the browser times render sections (each a JS clock call) only while the F7 panel shows.
